scope: Continuous [1,2] full positive atomic-mixture arrival oracle and source-cone-relative tilt proof; bounded exact rational original-space cross-checks only. No large source-tail MC in this registration.

common_source.each_component: Complete n-dimensional tensor uniform grid {m/k:-Ak<=m<=Ak}; q_k=2Ak+1, each atom mass q_k^-n. Coincident physical atoms sum in full mixture.
common_source.source_size_scope: Every component has the same n; fixed four layers across dimensions. No source-label dimension substitution.

critical_threshold.reference_probability: Under interior uniform Lebesgue lattice phase, high coordinate count is Bernoulli(1/2); this is not the source-cone prior or the full-mixture winner law.
critical_threshold.no_componentwise_max: Threshold uses a reference count map, but every oracle response, winner and M>tau decision uses the full mixture. Other components may change the actual critical regime; record rather than assert it.

arrival_oracle: Include R=1,2 and all coordinate arrivals 2|x_i-m/k| in (1,2]; deduplicate exact Fraction radii, group all simultaneous component/coordinate multiplicities, update counts first, then evaluate full mixture mass/R^n. Candidate completeness analytic; do not use a radius grid.

tilt.coordinates: Condition on source y, shell radius r, face/sign; tilt only the n-1 free coordinates. Core uses all n coordinates and its fixed cube1 prior.
tilt.high_set: Actual finite reference-grid centers whose closed reference-R interval contains two atoms; partition free-coordinate range at real lattice arrival center endpoints.
tilt.probability: p_i is exact prior length of the actual high set, including finite-body boundaries; Z_i=1-p_i+p_i*T
tilt.claim: Real receiver-cone prior RN; no conditional uniform mask assumption, no source probability as volume.

bounded_three_round_tests.receiver_types: Four rational face-cone receivers with many exact ties, four rational receivers with prime denominators to separate arrivals; record all exact locations and candidates.
bounded_three_round_tests.oracle_crosscheck: Independent all-atom scalar sorted-distance implementation for n1,2,3 tiny full mixtures; at main n values independent closed count recomputation at selected actual candidates.
bounded_three_round_tests.tilt_crosscheck: Actual finite high-set intervals and exact Poisson-binomial status laws; verify RN total mass, first high-count moment and registered critical count-tail identity. Not arbitrary free coins.
bounded_three_round_tests.confidence: No statistical CI: rational locations are implementation probes, not MC estimates of volume, I1, I2 or tail.
bounded_three_round_tests.complexity: O(n sum k) arrivals per receiver; sorting O(H log H); grouped integer product updates avoid complete q^n atom enumeration. Rational scores have dimension-dependent integer bit costs. Tilt high-set geometry O(n*k_ref); status-law cross-check O(n^2).
bounded_three_round_tests.stop_rule: Run only these bounded cross-checks after reporting registration. Do not launch large receiver/source rare-event simulation or optimize tau after results.
